# Particles

> An open specification and reference implementation for AI-system memory as
> an append-only ledger of claims: each belief is one sourced, dated,
> confidence-scored claim ("particle"); corrections supersede rather than
> overwrite; trust, doubt, and staleness are applied at query time under a
> changeable policy; contradictions are kept as first-class records.

The specification is implementation-independent; the reference
implementation is `pip install linkedparticles` (Python 3.11+, CLI + HTTP
API + MCP server).

## Docs

- [Why Particles](https://linkedparticles.org/why/): the argument, the
  comparison with other memory systems, benchmark results and caveats
- [Walkthrough](https://linkedparticles.org/walkthrough/): the
  deposit → extract → query loop with real output, and as-of time travel
- [Whitepaper](https://linkedparticles.org/spec/whitepaper/): motivation and
  design
- [Technical specification](https://linkedparticles.org/spec/technical-specification/):
  the formal schema, operations, and conformance contract
- [Conformance profile](https://linkedparticles.org/spec/conformance-profile/):
  what a conforming implementation must do
- [Vocabulary](https://linkedparticles.org/vocab/): every term at the
  identifier it resolves to
- [SDK documentation](https://docs.linkedparticles.org/): user, operator, and
  plugin-author guides, CLI reference, HTTP API

## Machine-readable artifacts

- [JSON Schema](https://linkedparticles.org/schemas/particle.schema.json)
- [JSON-LD context](https://linkedparticles.org/schemas/context.jsonld)
- [Interchange schema](https://linkedparticles.org/schemas/interchange.schema.json)
- [Trust-lens schema](https://linkedparticles.org/schemas/trust_lens.schema.json)
- [SHACL shapes](https://linkedparticles.org/schemas/shacl/ParticleShape.ttl):
  also SubjectShape, ProvenanceChainShape, CorpusSnapshotShape,
  TrustStatementShape at the same path

## Code

- [Engine](https://github.com/LinkedParticles/particles-engine-py): reference
  implementation (PyPI: `linkedparticles`)
- [Client library](https://github.com/LinkedParticles/particles-core-py):
  store-free schema + extraction (PyPI: `linkedparticles-core`)
- [Specification repo](https://github.com/LinkedParticles/particles-standard)
